def row_fingerprint(term):
    src = "|".join([
        "%.3f" % frappe.utils.flt(term.payment_amount, 3),
        term.mode_of_payment or "",
        term.custom_banque or "",
        term.custom__n_chèque__transaction or "",
        str(frappe.utils.getdate(term.due_date)) if term.due_date else "",
    ])
    return frappe.utils.sha256_hash(src)

def claim_unlinked(unlinked, mode, amount):
    chosen = None
    chosen_idx = -1
    target = round(frappe.utils.flt(amount, 3), 3)
    for i in range(len(unlinked)):
        p = unlinked[i]
        if p.mode_of_payment == mode and round(frappe.utils.flt(p.paid_amount, 3), 3) == target:
            chosen = p
            chosen_idx = i
            break
    if chosen_idx >= 0:
        unlinked.pop(chosen_idx)
    return chosen
